title: Named-graphs-only gate fixture
description: Every quad lives in a named graph and the default graph is EMPTY — the nkod.rete shape that made a correct 0 answer read as a broken page. The gate uses it to assert the empty-default-graph explainer appears here (card: triple_count 0, named_graph_count > 0) and nowhere else, that this card's own example queries populate the examples panel for an off-catalog file (including the zero-row one, with the near-duplicate deduplicated), and that the ⛁ All graphs union toggle turns the standard 0 into the union answer.
example_queries:
PREFIX dct: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
SELECT ?g ?title WHERE { GRAPH ?g { ?s dct:title ?title } } LIMIT 50

PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
select ?graph ?t where { graph ?graph { ?doc dcterms:title ?t } } limit 10
